Your Choices Regarding Cookies
When you visit our website, it may store or retrieve information on your browser in the form of cookies and other tracking technologies (“cookies”).  This information might be about you, your preferences or your device and is used for the purposes set out in our Privacy Policy.



Strictly necessary cookies are always active and cannot be rejected.  These cookies enable the website to function. You can accept or reject the other types of cookies.  You can click on the different category headings to find out more, reject a particular type of cookie, or change your default setting for that cookie.


Once you change the default settings, click “Confirm my Choices” to save your selections.  However, blocking some types of cookies may impact your experience on the site and the services we are able to offer, and result in less relevant advertising.



Your cookie preferences are brand, browser, and device specific. Therefore, if you visit other Pharmavite brands, visit the brands of our subsidiaries, visit this Site from a different browser or device, or clear your cookies, you will need to reset your cookie preferences.


Strictly Necessary Cookies
Always Active
These cookies are necessary for the website to function and cannot be switched off in our systems. They are usually only set in response to actions made by you which amount to a request for services, such as setting your privacy preferences, logging in or filling in forms. You can set your browser to block or alert you about these cookies, but some parts of the site will not then work. These cookies do not store any personally identifiable information.
Performance Cookies
  
These cookies allow us to count visits and traffic sources so we can measure and improve the performance of our site. They help us to know which pages are the most and least popular and see how visitors move around the site. All information these cookies collect is aggregated and therefore anonymous. DYK: 1 cup of pineapple provides 88% of the DV of Vitamin C? 
This essential nutrient is important for collagen production, which supports healthy skin. Hit “Save” on this one! 📌

INGREDIENTS:
🍍 1 large pineapple, peeled, cored, and cut into 1-inch cubes
🍍 Maple syrup (or substitute honey or brown sugar)
🍍 Cinnamon

HOW-TO:
- Preheat your air fryer to 380°F (lightly spray with nonstick spray if you like)

- Toss pineapple chunks with 1 tablespoon of maple syrup and cinnamon.

- Arrange glazed pineapple chunks in the heated air fryer basket, ensuring they don’t overlap too much.

- Air fry for 12-16 minutes, shaking halfway through until golden, juicy, and tender.

- Enjoy as a topper on plain or vanilla-flavored Greek yogurt!

A summer dessert we’re posset-ive you’ll like! Never heard of a posset? It’s a dessert typically made with cream, sugar, and lemon juice that thickens when the acid in the lemon juice interacts with the cream.
 
🍋 Vitamin C from lemons to support immune health
 
🥛 Vitamins A, D, E & calcium from heavy cream

The cutest way to nourish your sweet tooth this summer. What other fruits would you want to make possets from?

INGREDIENTS
🍋6 lemons, pulp removed and juiced. Zest of 1 lemon
🍋2 cups heavy cream
🍋½ cup sugar
🍋½ cup freeze-dried strawberries, crushed
🍋Fresh strawberry slices

RECIPE
1. Cut lemons in half and remove pulp. Strain pulp for juice, around 6 tbsp.
2. In a pot, bring heavy cream to medium-low heat. Stir in sugar & lemon zest.
3. After 4 minutes, remove from heat and gently stir in lemon juice.
4. Set lemon halves on a baking sheet (trim the rounded edges if the halves are not able to sit up). Pour lemon mixture into halves and refrigerate for 2-5 hours.
5. (Optional!) Grind freeze-dried strawberries and sprinkle over lemon possets. Garnish with fresh strawberry slices.
 
#lemonrecipe #lemonposset #summerdessert #dessertrecipe #lemons #easyrecipe

Looking for fiber and protein in your daily snack? 💪🧠
 
This delicious Strawberry Chia pudding delivers both – and Omega 3s to boot! Thanks, Chia Seeds!
 
🎥: @holisticwhisk
 
INGREDIENTS:
🍓 1 cup dairy-free milk of choice
🍓 1 scoop protein powder
🍓 1 tsp. lemon juice 
🍓 1/4 cup chia seeds
🍓 1 cup strawberries, frozen
 
RECIPE
1. Blend the milk, protein powder, and lemon juice until smooth. Pour it into a mixing bowl so you can stir in the chia seeds. Allow it to rest for 10 minutes.
2. Divide between 2 jars and top with strawberries (gently heat up some frozen ones with a splash of water).
3. Refrigerate overnight + enjoy!
